name: University of Piraeus
summary: Piraeus public university with four schools; undergraduate departments are Greek-taught and English is for master's programmes.

ib.text: EU citizen with the IB: apply in the Ministry's foreign-school graduates category (one parent not of Greek origin, last two school years abroad); no exam, ranked on certificate grade; Greek B2 needed to enrol.

lastYear.text: apply online 2–9 July; courier postmark by 10 July

apply.via: Ministry of Education form for foreign-school graduates

notes: Its International Programmes page lists only English-speaking postgraduate programmes for 2026-27.
Its Erasmus fact sheet says the main language of instruction is Greek, with English arrangements only for exchange students.
